name: Transparent Top Bar (Auto Foreground)
description:
Transparent top bar with adjustable opacity and an automatic dark or light foreground color.

The background behind the bar is sampled separately for the desktop, the overview and the lock screen, so the bar stays readable on any wallpaper and also with extensions that change the overview background (e.g. Blur my Shell).

Based on Transparent Top Bar by zhanghai and lamarios. Does not work well with custom shell themes.
